items: `TestDLC2Lurker` 014494:Dragonborn.esm, the Lurker that rises from a freed standing stone, is listed on the Lurker row (vanilla 32) and is to be set to the Lurker's level. Despite its EditorID it is live: the activator `DLC2PillarShoutTrigger` 028662:Dragonborn.esm (5 refs in the `DLC2SolstheimWorld` persistent cell) spawns it through its script property DLC2PillarMonster. It has no template, so changing `DLC2EncLurker01` does not move it.
`DLC2EncLurker02`–`04` template `DLC2EncLurker01` without the `Stats` or `BaseData` flag, so each keeps its own level and name when 01 changes.
Every row: no other record keeps its own level.
Every other Lurker record (the `DLC2LvlLurker` and `DLC2LvlLurkerAmbush` wrappers, the `ccPEWSSE002_SummonLurker` summon) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
